dct_description_sm: Shrubs have been reported to increase in dominance in response to climate warming in the tundra biomes. Our general aim is to quantify the abundance and distribution of Salix richardsonii, the only erected shrub species in the region.  We hypothesize that soil moisture, deepening of the active layer and moderate perturbations associated to alluvial fans promote the growth of the species. Transects and plots were set along a gradient of abundance in populations of Salix richardsonii linked to alluvial fans in the Qarlikturvik valley, Bylot Island. A subset of plots was studied for dendrochronological analyses.
dct_title_s: Distribution of the erect shrub Salix richardsonii at its northern range of distribution on Bylot Island, Nunavut
